Calm late-afternoon natural light, documentary architectural rendering, human-scale, detailed but not glossy. Preserve ambiguity: this is a future concept, not a photograph of an existing approved project. No readable text, no logos, no corporate branding, no cyberpunk, no skyscrapers, no utopian megastructure, no surveillance cameras emphasized.
